7040.title: Approval authority after steering
7040.rootCauseOneLine: Incoming steer options replace the runtime approval gate and can bypass interaction registration; current Codex synchronizes native permission changes by restarting the turn.
7040.proposedFix: Define a server-owned distinction between informational input and permission revocation before changing authority; add privacy-safe denial provenance.
7040.caveats: Runtime suppression reproduced twice with a scripted provider; current Codex stale-policy transition not reproduced. No live installed-provider run. Authorization semantics disqualify an autopilot fix. Test patch and output are inline per reports repository policy.
